pretreatments.description: Milling (grinding) of dried pine needles in an electric blender.
Steam explosion of pine needles, involving autoclaving in a flask plugged with non-absorbent cotton at 121 °C for 30 min.

Acid-base-acid pretreatment involving repeated exposure to HCl and NaOH with 30 min cycle, until the wash out liquid was clear, followed by repeated washings with water until neutral pH of the wash out liquid was obtained.
Staining with 1% (w/w) KMnO4 solution and coating with gold for FE-SEM-EDS analysis.
Preparation of FT-IR samples using KBr technology (making pellets).
